pkgmetadata.longdescription: GeST (Gentoo System Tool) is a modular, YaST-style system administration tool for Gentoo: a full-screen urwid TUI over a layered core, with every privileged action routed through a root D-Bus service and gated by polkit. Modules cover software (Portage: search, transactional install/update/remove, USE/keyword/mask editing, @world update, depclean, tree sync, news, repositories, licenses, and binary-package hosts), system settings (hostname, timezone, locale, eselect, bootloader and kernel, make.conf, date and time), OpenRC services, users and groups, storage (disks and mounts), hardware and CPU/video flags, and network interfaces (netifrc).

use.flag: Install the optional Qt/Wayland Control Center (dev-python/pyside), providing the gest-settings graphical frontend embedded by the Helm Desktop Environment (HeDE).
